technical_complexity.rationale: Card issuing runs on partner banks and card platforms; the work is underwriting, partner deal sourcing and spend tracking.

defensibility.rationale: Rewards and vendor perks are copyable by large card players; partner deals and a niche focus give limited edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Amex launched AI related card benefits and several startups market AI spend cards by 2026; no acquisition of ernd found.

market_need_then: Ramp's 2026 spending report tracks AI subscriptions, API tokens and GPU spend as a distinct category; ernd says 30+ startups requested the card in its first week (company claim).
